WITH year_total_store AS (
    SELECT c_customer_id customer_id, c_first_name customer_first_name, c_last_name customer_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag customer_preferred_cust_flag, 
           c_birth_country customer_birth_country, c_login customer_login, c_email_address customer_email_address, d_year dyear, 
           SUM(ss_ext_list_price-ss_ext_discount_amt) year_total, 's' sale_type 
    FROM customer JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 1998 AND year_total > 0
    GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, 
             c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year
), year_total_web AS (
    SELECT c_customer_id customer_id, c_first_name customer_first_name, c_last_name customer_last_name, 
           c_preferred_cust_flag customer_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country customer_birth_country, 
           c_login customer_login, c_email_address customer_email_address, d_year dyear, 
           SUM(ws_ext_list_price-ws_ext_discount_amt) year_total, 'w' sale_type 
    FROM customer JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 1998 AND year_total > 0
    GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, 
             c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year
), year_total AS (
    SELECT * FROM year_total_store UNION ALL SELECT * FROM year_total_web
)
SELECT t_s_secyear.customer_id, t_s_secyear.customer_first_name, 
       t_s_secyear.customer_last_name, t_s_secyear.customer_email_address 
FROM year_total AS t_s_firstyear
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT year_total/t_s_firstyear.year_total AS ratio FROM year_total WHERE customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id AND sale_type = 'w' AND dyear = 1998) t_w_firstyear
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT year_total/t_s_firstyear.year_total AS ratio FROM year_total WHERE customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id AND sale_type = 's' AND dyear = 1998+1) t_s_secyear
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT year_total/t_w_firstyear.year_total AS ratio FROM year_total WHERE customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id AND sale_type = 'w' AND dyear = 1998+1) t_w_secyear
WHERE t_s_firstyear.dyear IN (1998, 1998+1) 
AND CASE WHEN t_w_firstyear.ratio > 0 THEN t_w_secyear.ratio > t_w_firstyear.ratio ELSE FALSE END
ORDER BY t_s_secyear.customer_id, t_s_secyear.customer_first_name, 
         t_s_secyear.customer_last_name, t_s_secyear.customer_email_address LIMIT 100
